what: How the chords are played (the rhythm of the chord part per section kind) and voiced (which notes beyond the triad). options.label: Held pad under spaced-out stabs
options.what: Two chord parts. A pad holds each chord from where it starts to where the next one starts (re-struck every bar in builds), an octave under the stabs, through intros, verses, drops and breaks. Over it, short stabs come in small groups with whole bars of space between them: a touch in the verses, a push that fills up through the build, two or three hits and then air in the drops, none in the break. Neither part plays all the time.
options.how: The person (2026-10-29): the synths follow the voice's chords, not persistent and not constant short stabs, a mixture: long chords that pad underneath and stabby sounds spaced out. Use with voiceharmony.section_loops for chords that follow the voice section by section.
